query: When approaching a side road, what should drivers do regarding vehicles entering from it?
reference_answer: Give way to vehicles from the side road entering the main road.
context:
[Document 1]
Give way to vehicles from the side road entering the main road.

[Document 2]
It warns drivers that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential adjustments in lane position.

[Document 3]
Drivers should proceed to complete their turn and clear the junction.

[Document 4]
It indicates that vehicles can proceed straight ahead as well as make a right turn.

[Document 5]
It indicates the centre line of a two-way road.
answer: When approaching a side road, drivers should give way to vehicles entering the main road from it [Document 1]. They also need to be cautious as the road ahead may narrow, requiring potential lane adjustments [Document 2]. After completing their turn and clearing the junction, drivers can proceed straight or make a right turn [Document 3 & Document 4].
